company.name: Meter Feeder
company.shortDescription: Meter Feeder provides a low cost parking payment and enforcement solution for individuals and small to mid-sized government agencies.
company.description: Meter Feeder's mission to provide a low cost payment and enforcement solution for small to mid-sized governments. A fast set up process and geolocation get new users paid and on their way fast.  MeterFeeder works with customers' current infrastructure. Users don't need to purchase any new meters or kiosks, growing the base of people more willing to pay via electronic payments.

aiResearchSummary.text: Meter Feeder is focused on developing an autonomous vehicle parking system, which involves a parking system server that communicates electronically with autonomous vehicles. The server processes parking location requests and identifies suitable parking zones, aligning with Meter Feeder's mission to provide cost-effective parking payment and enforcement solutions. This research highlights their commitment to integrating advanced technology into parking management, enhancing efficiency for individuals and government agencies.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,600,000, or 61.82% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,674,593 to $18,879,086, a 11.27x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 46 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 53 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
